svg.title: WORLD_MAP v1.0 - The Quarry (top-down, to scale)
svg.text: The Quarry — WORLD_MAP.md v1.0 (top-down, north up, 1 px = 1.25 studs)
The Gate: Scav Camp (exit faces bowl)
The Plaza: truce square, first spawn
B buyer · S seats · C bench
Plot number = fill order. Heavy ring = railed Rim road. Inner dashed rings = top of slope, Pit edge. Thin rays = compass mosaic.
Camp escape ring (dashed orange) = 60 studs. Outer dashed arcs = unreachable cliffs (set back to r 320 behind the Plaza).
